fact: The World Bank SASPP program summary of July 2026 says the Social Registry has been used by 30 programs for beneficiary selection, that the Social Registry and program-specific management information systems are not interoperable, and that 25 percent of regular Tekavoul cash transfers go through digital payments, most having been paid in cash.
title: MAURITANIA: Summary of SASPP-Supported Mauritania Resilience and Productive Safety Nets Program
